title: Proxy War
description: House Vantry dammed the upper stream above Millbrook to water their own herds first, and House Corliss will not wait on a magistrate. Corliss's coin is real and the dispute is not mine to judge. Nobody has asked the shepherds.

objectives.description: Meet House Corliss's agent near Millbrook
Win the first skirmish over the dammed stream
Break Vantry's reinforcements when they arrive
Lead the decisive battle against Vantry's commander
Offer Vantry's commander terms, if you choose to
Report to Steele who holds the uplands now

notes: Named Houses Corliss and Vantry over grazing uplands above Mill Brook, invented, no bible basis, deliberately placed above rather than inside Millbrook proper so it doesn't contradict millbrook_bandits' elder-run hamlet. Threat: shepherds who graze the disputed land answer to whichever house wins, unconsulted. Giver motive: Steele took Corliss's coin, not Corliss's cause - stated plainly as the 'morally gray' the old description only claimed. Consequence: negotiate_terms is a single optional talk objective with no choice_consequences behind it - the description's implied surrender/annihilation fork is not wired. A full fix needs a real OR group added to objectives, which this pass cannot do.
